title: Sunset Bloom
description: A vibrant quilled floral arrangement inspired by golden hour. Delicate paper strips are hand-rolled into petals and leaves, creating a three-dimensional bouquet that catches the light beautifully. Each petal is individually shaped and layered to give depth and movement to the composition.

title: Ocean Mandala
description: A mesmerising mandala pattern in ocean blues and teals. Inspired by the rhythm of waves, this piece features concentric rings of tightly coiled paper that radiate outward in a calming, symmetrical design. Perfect for adding a serene focal point to any room.

title: Eucalyptus Wreath
description: A delicate circular wreath of quilled eucalyptus leaves in soft greens and silvers. This Australian-inspired piece brings a touch of native flora indoors, with each leaf carefully shaped to capture the gentle curve and silvery sheen of real eucalyptus foliage.
